description: First P1 vertical slice: SUV/crossover models a buyer with ~EGP 2M would consider.

rules.price_rule: at least one numeric official_price in S0 (2026-09-10) for the model falls in, or the model's official price range overlaps, the band (+/-20% of EGP 2.0M)
rules.registration_rule: passenger first-registrations in the window via ACCEPTED registration aliases >= registration_min
rules.note: Models that pass the price rule but whose registration link is REJECTED/unresolved are kept in the output with in_slice=false and a gap entry, so P1 sees them as known-unknowns.
